name: Kevin
site: rheinenergie.com · Energy and water supplier, Germany
headline: Turn RheinEnergie’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells electricity, gas, water and heat tariffs to households and businesses alike, and every visitor sees the same offer and the same call to action: calculate your tariff online.

Your customers already give you the strongest signal: a meter reading submitted, a monthly instalment adjusted, a login to their account, a click on a green power tariff. That signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.
Tariff, family and business campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The household about to cancel its contract this week gets the same promotion as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the switch before the contract ends
cases.text: Churn signals per household from meter readings, instalment changes and account logins. The right offer, channel and moment for each customer, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the tariff that fits each home
cases.text: Next best tariff, green power or family add-on for each customer, triggered by their consumption. No more blanket tariff mails to customers already on the right contract.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep customers engaged with their account
cases.text: Personal messages in email and account, showing each customer their usage, a relevant tip and a reason to log in again, every week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
